MASTER-OAGH robotic telescope  [1]  located in Mexico (OAGH National Institute for Astrophysics, Optics and Electronics) started inspect of the Fermi GRB260522.40 (trigger No 801135305,18h 40m 52.08s , -25d 33m 00.0s, R=7.7) errorbox  88 sec after notice time and 124 sec after trigger time at 2026-05-22 09:37:04 UT, with upper limit up to  18.4 mag. The observations began at zenith distance = 57 deg. The sun  altitude  is -28.5 deg. 

The galactic latitude b = -10 deg., longitude l =  9 deg.


Real time updated cover map and OT discovered available here: 
https://master.sai.msu.ru/site/master2/observ.php?id=3331401
